select fa.name as `key`, round(coalesce(s.balance, 0), 2) as `value` from financial_account fa left join ( select account_id, balance from account_balance_snapshot abs1 inner join ( select account_id aid, max(snapshot_date) maxd from account_balance_snapshot group by account_id ) abs2 on abs1.account_id = abs2.aid and abs1.snapshot_date = abs2.maxd ) s on s.account_id = fa.id where coalesce(fa.deleted, 0) = 0 order by fa.display_order, fa.name

select coalesce(sum(coalesce(t.balance_money, 0)), 0) from transaction t left join consume_category cat on cat.code = t.consume_code and cat.deleted != 1 where t.transaction_date >= #{since,jdbcType=DATE} and (cat.txn_types like '%expense%' or (cat.code is null and coalesce(t.balance_money,0) > 0))

select coalesce(sum( case when coalesce(t.income_money,0) > 0 then t.income_money when coalesce(t.balance_money,0) < 0 then abs(t.balance_money) else 0 end ), 0) from transaction t where t.transaction_date >= #{since,jdbcType=DATE}

select coalesce(sum(coalesce(t.balance_money, 0)), 0) from transaction t left join consume_category cat on cat.code = t.consume_code and cat.deleted != 1 where year(t.transaction_date) = #{year,jdbcType=INTEGER} and ( cat.code like '%rent%' or cat.code like '%mortgage%' or t.transaction_desc like '%房贷%' or t.transaction_desc like '%房租%' or cat.code like '%fixed%' )

select md5(concat( coalesce(date_format(t.transaction_date,'%Y-%m-%d'),''), '|', coalesce(round(abs(coalesce(t.balance_money,0) + coalesce(t.income_money,0)),2),''), '|', coalesce(t.transaction_desc,''), '|', coalesce(t.bank_card_id,'') )) as fp from transaction t where md5(concat( coalesce(date_format(t.transaction_date,'%Y-%m-%d'),''), '|', coalesce(round(abs(coalesce(t.balance_money,0) + coalesce(t.income_money,0)),2),''), '|', coalesce(t.transaction_desc,''), '|', coalesce(#{bankCardId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') )) in ( select md5(concat( coalesce(date_format(x.transaction_date,'%Y-%m-%d'),''), '|', coalesce(round(abs(coalesce(x.balance_money,0) + coalesce(x.income_money,0)),2),''), '|', coalesce(x.transaction_desc,''), '|', coalesce(x.bank_card_id,'') )) from transaction x )

select distinct tt.id from transaction_temp tt inner join transaction t on date_format(tt.transaction_date,'%Y-%m-%d') = date_format(t.transaction_date,'%Y-%m-%d') and round(abs(coalesce(tt.balance_money,0) + coalesce(tt.income_money,0)), 2) = round(abs(coalesce(t.balance_money,0) + coalesce(t.income_money,0)), 2) and coalesce(tt.transaction_desc,'') = coalesce(t.transaction_desc,'') and coalesce(tt.bank_card_id,'') = coalesce(t.bank_card_id,'') where tt.recordID = #{statementId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and coalesce(tt.deleted, 0) = 0 and (t.txn_kind is null or t.txn_kind = '' or t.txn_kind != 'transfer')
